bannerText: Muse X Poster: bài đã điền sẵn (đã bỏ tag Binance). Bấm Post trên X để đăng, rồi báo Muse là xong.
note: Muse X Poster v1.9: REMOVED THE WRONG ORBIT POKE (user 2026-11-16 ~13:51, screenshot). The paused extension is X AI: Auto Reply + Smart Scheduler v2.3.0 (id abnianljjegaphncoioigdmojljkfc), a third-party extension on the SAME Chrome as this poster; the Orbit poster runs on ANOTHER Chrome and is never paused. v1.8 sent ORBIT_POLL_NOW to the resumed id, built on the wrong assumption it was Orbit; v1.9 removes the poke entirely. Chrome offers no API for one extension to press another extension’s popup button; the only hooks are enable/disable and external messages the target opts into, and X AI publishes no such API. v1.7 watchdog + postClicked milestone are unchanged.
